name: Yakitate Croissant ~Autumn Leaf no 3 Shimai~
original_name: やきたてクロワッサン ～Autumn Leafの3姉妹～
source:
Main lives with his aunt and three cousins after losing mother and sister. Aunt runs a cafe, so protagonist has to help around the place. As one cousin starts to have feelings for protagonist, the other two become really jealous and join the race.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-february-2005-steel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
